Article Title
Unit Inactive Duty Trainin g Record Maintenance
• Substantial changes have been made to this article and it should be read
in its entirety.
• Transitioning the Unit IDT Record to a historical paper record for pre-
Enhancement for Drill Management (EDM) IDT transactions.
• There is no requirement to maintain a Unit IDT Record for current drill
operations.
• Removed the requirement for DD Form 577s, Unit Recall Rosters, and
earnings statements to be maintained within the Unit IDT Folder.
(COG: COMNAVRESFORCOM (NI I))

1. Purpose. In accordance with references (a) through ( e), this article addresses the proper
maintenance of historical unit inactive duty training (IDT) records occurring prior to the full
establishment of Enhancement for Drill Management (EDM) in October 2017
2. Definitions:
a. EDM. An automated Navy Reserve drill management functionality in the Navy Standard
Integrated Personnel System (NSIPS). Provides the Navy Reserve with automated 24/7 self­
service drill management capability for managing drill periods.
b. IDT Partici pation Record. NA VRES 1570/21. Historical form used to manually muster
unit drill period participation outside of EDM.
3. Navy Reserve Activit y (NRA) Responsibilities. In accordance with references (a) and (c), all
documentation that supports financial statement balances shall be retained in the current records
management system for 10 years. The Navy Reserve Activity (NRA) will maintain individual
unit-IDT aecountin-g-reeords for documents-prior to the ful-1-establishment of EDM in October
2017. Unit IDTs mustered in EDM, and corrective actions taken, are electronically recorded on
and stored indefinitely in EDM.
a. Unit IDT Partici pation Record. Historical records prior to October 2017 will contain:
(1) Completed NAVRES 1570/21, Unit IDT Participation Records.
(2) Unit IDT unadjudicated report with corrective actions taken for unadjudicated IDTs.

(3) NSIPS IDT verification records that were approved, signed, and dated by NRA
Commanding Officer or designated representative.
( 4) Any additional historical or relevant key supporting documents, already in the current
Unit IDT record, such as past earnings statements, designation letters, and unit recall lists.
b. Records Maintenance. In accordance with reference (c), NRAs will use the Navy's
authorized records management system for storage of electronic records. NRAs will establish
and maintain electronic records in the records management system for each assigned Reserve
Sailor, using the naming convention promulgated in reference ( c ). Local records are authorized
and encouraged when the Navy is transitioning records management systems or the systems are
inoperable for an extended duration.
